verdict.rationale: Cooley GO publishes web guidance and document generators, so offering agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented or machine-readable documentation. Cooley AI is an internal tool for the firm's lawyers, not agent-facing docs for users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
